shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && git diff --stat && sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/types/messages.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/index.ts && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
rg -n \"ListSessionsMessage|SessionListMessage|SessionSummaryFrame|list_sessions|session_list\" src --glob '*test.ts' --glob '"'!src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts'"'
rg -n \"validated by|VALIDATED_BY|specs/.*#\" specs src --glob '*.md' --glob '*test.ts' | head -120
rg -n \"createMessageHandler\\(\" src/transport/createServer.ts src --glob '*test.ts' | head -120
sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/createServer.ts
cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,110p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/types/sessionStore.ts
sed -n '1,130p' src/types/session.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/sender.ts
sed -n '1,90p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '90,125p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:\" src --glob '*test.ts' | head -60
rg -n \"tests.list|descriptor.*spec|spec anchor\" scripts .lore | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/types/messages.ts src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts && git commit -m "Handle WebSocket conversation lists" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
